sentences.text:
Vikash Goyal & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 2
March, 2026
02.03.2026 Sl. No.15.
M/L. Mithun.

Crr/1003/2026 Vikash Goyal & Ors.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mrs. Priyanka Sarkar, Mr. Aasish Choudhury, Ms. Meera Agarwal ... for the petitioners

This is an application wherein petitioners have prayed for quashing of the proceeding being G.R. Case No.830 of 2020 pending before learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bidhannagar under Sections 420/467/468/471/120B of the Indian Penal Code.

Being aggrieved by the instant proceeding learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that the allegation regarding forgery pertains to a letter dated 20th December, 2018 addressed to the mother of the petitioners, Smt. Kamla Devi Goyal and allegedly executed by opposite party no.2.

However,
in CRR 2730 of 2022, a Coordinate Bench of this Court has exonerated the said Kamla Devi Goyal from the allegation of committing forgery on the grounds mentioned therein.

In such circumstances,
the allegation of forgery or cheating cannot stand against the present petitioners who being the sons of said Kamla Devi Goyal and not being a tenant in respect of the property are on a better footing than that of Kamla Devi Goyal.
Therefore, continuance of further proceeding on the allegation of forgery and cheating against the present petitioners will be mere abuse of the process of the Court.

Therefore, petitioners have prayed for quashing of the impugned proceeding.
Having heard learned Counsel for the petitioners

Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of application upon the State through the office of Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and upon opposite party no.2 through speed post intimating next date of hearing and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.
Let the matter be listed under the heading "To Be Mentioned" on 9th April, 2026.

Having heard learned Counsel for the petitioners and that the petitioners have made out an arguable case, let all further proceeding of G.R.Case No.830 of 2020 pending before learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bidhannagar be stayed for a period of 12 weeks or until further order, whichever is earlier.
